name: Miles Painting Playbook
label: Painting
summary: Book exteriors before the weather window opens, switch to interiors and cabinets when it closes, and let local SEO and before/after photos do the heavy lifting. Use with the Miles Master Template (deploy logic, ZIP scoring, customer journey).

sections.title: Intro
lines: Book exteriors before the weather window opens, switch to interiors and cabinets when it closes, and let local SEO and before/after photos do the heavy lifting. Use with the Miles Master Template (deploy logic, ZIP scoring, customer journey).

sections.title: 1. At a glance
lines: Exterior repaint (spring–fall); interior and cabinet refinishing (winter)
Standard exterior latex needs about 50°F+ during application and cure; cold-weather lines go down to 35°F and extend the season by up to ~2 months
Local SEO: Painters in Philly drove 1,418 leads with $0 paid

sections.title: 2. Seasonality by region
lines: Sell exterior Feb–Apr for summer slots
Sell exterior Jan–Mar; fall exterior Aug–Sep
Ideal exterior conditions are about 50–80°F with humidity around 40–70%. Overnight lows matter as much as daytime highs.

sections.title: 3. Location signals (add to ZIP score)
lines: Median year built and siding type: wood-sided and older homes repaint more often.
Home value and income: premium paint, cabinet refinishing, and color design sell in higher-value ZIPs.
Recent home sales (move-in interior repaints) and HOA communities (scheduled exterior cycles).
Pre-1978 housing share: lead-safe practices required (see compliance).

sections.title: 4. Demographics and audiences
lines: Exterior buyer: homeowner 40–70, longer tenure, preparing to sell or protecting the house.
Interior / cabinet buyer: 30–55, recent movers and remodel-minded; design-driven.
Property managers and HOAs: recurring turnover and community repaint contracts.
Audiences: recent movers, home-improvement interests in scored ZIPs, past customers for the next room.

Load with the Audience framework in the Master Template. Emergency segments get no income or homeowner filter and start at 25+; planned segments use the filters below. Ages are starting points: Miles tightens them from closed-won CRM data after 30 booked jobs.
owner-occupied >= 65%; wood/older siding; median home value above area median
Search: house painters, exterior painting; observe Homeowners; exclude Renters
Exclude in every segment: customers from the last 12 months (except retention campaigns), open leads and estimates, employees, out-of-area ZIPs.

sections.title: 5. Offer stack
lines: Free color consult + written estimate within [48] hrs
$[X] off exterior repaint booked by [date] (early-booking discount)
$[X] off interior rooms or cabinet refinishing Nov–Mar
Trim, doors, decks/stain, cabinet refinishing, power washing
Next-room credit; touch-up visit at year 1; 5–7-year exterior repaint reminder

sections.title: 6. Channels and campaign build
lines: Local SEO + Google Business Profile first: service pages (exterior, interior, cabinets) + location pages for real service areas; project photos every job.
Search + LSA for "house painters [city]", "cabinet painting"; negatives: jobs, DIY, paint store, art, auto painting.
Meta: before/after video and carousel; early-booking exterior offer Jan–Apr; interior offer in fall.
Yard signs and neighbor postcards around active exterior jobs (with permission).

sections.title: 7. Triggers Miles watches
lines: Open exterior campaigns in that region
Shift budget to interior and cabinet offers
Text booked customers; offer interior swap slots

sections.title: 8. After the job and retention
lines: Before/after photos on every job (with consent) for GBP, site and Meta.
Thank-you coupon toward the next room; honest review ask to everyone; referral offer with a neighborhood project photo.
Exterior repaint reminder at year 5–7; touch-up visit at year 1.

sections.title: 9. Compliance and watch-outs
lines: Homes built before 1978: follow EPA lead-safe (RRP) rules and use certified renovators.
Don't promise exterior start dates the weather can't support; state weather-delay terms.
Use only real job photos in ads.

sections.title: 10. Deploy checklist
lines: ☐ Confirm services (exterior, interior, cabinets, commercial) and RRP certification
☐ Map region; set the exterior/interior switch dates and temperature triggers
☐ Load early-booking, off-season interior, and next-room offers
☐ Build GBP, service and location pages; Search + LSA; Meta before/after
☐ Turn on estimate follow-up (multi-quote buyers), post-job photo capture, review and referral automations

Sources: 50°F minimum and 8-hour cure (Diamond Vogel) · 35°F products extend season ~2 months (Sherwin-Williams) · ideal temperature and humidity (Ring's End) · Painters in Philly results from Akhil's 1SEO work.
